info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Liquidity Risk Models API
info.description: The Liquidity Risk Models API provides essential access to the models used for evaluating and managing liquidity risk within financial institutions. It enables users to retrieve detailed information about various liquidity risk models that are instrumental in risk assessment and decision-making processes. Typical consumers of this API include risk analysts, financial managers, and compliance officers who require up-to-date model data to inform their strategies and regulatory reporting. This API supports financial entities in maintaining robust liquidity management practices.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access a list of liquidity risk models available in the system, providing important insights for financial risk management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of liquidity risk models. Ensure that the request follows the specified schema for successful operation.

200.description: Successful retrieval of liquidity risk models.
